# random forest regression
```{r data }
# random forest regression
library(ranger)
```


```{r}
# view data set

url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "reinesana/STAT440-star-kingdom-project/",
  "main/data/train_predict_cost.csv"
)

df <- read.csv(url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
View(df)

```


```{r}
dim(df)
names(df)
head(df)
```

```{r}
# doenload data and distribute
set.seed(440)

# 1. GitHub data
url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "reinesana/STAT440-star-kingdom-project/",
  "main/data/train_predict_cost.csv")

df <- read.csv(url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Create leak year from date
df$date <- as.Date(df$date)
df$event_year <- as.integer(format(df$date, "%Y"))

# 3. Explanatory variables used this time
features <- c(
  "material",
  "surface",
  "pipe_length",
  "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x",
  "midpoint_y",
  "event_year"
)

# Check required columns
required <- c("pipe_id", "date", "cost", features)
stopifnot(all(required %in% names(df)))

# 4. Study from 2019 to 2022, test only from 2023
train <- subset(df, event_year >= 2019 & event_year <= 2022)
test  <- subset(df, event_year == 2023)

stopifnot(nrow(train) > 0, nrow(test) > 0)

# If there are missing values, etc., stop without deleting them.
used <- c("cost", features)
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(train[, used]),
  !anyNA(test[, used]),
  all(train$cost > 0),
  all(test$cost > 0)
)

numeric_cols <- setdiff(used, c("material", "surface"))

stopifnot(
  all(vapply(train[numeric_cols],
             function(x) is.numeric(x) && all(is.finite(x)),
             logical(1))),
  all(vapply(test[numeric_cols],
             function(x) is.numeric(x) && all(is.finite(x)),
             logical(1)))
)

# 5. Categories match learning data
for (col in c("material", "surface")) {

  categories <- sort(unique(train[[col]]))
  unseen <- setdiff(unique(test[[col]]), categories)

  if (length(unseen) > 0) {
    stop(paste(
      "Some categories are missing from the training data:",
      col, paste(unseen, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  train[[col]] <- factor(train[[col]], levels = categories)
  test[[col]]  <- factor(test[[col]], levels = categories)
}

cat("Training: 2019–2022,", nrow(train), "rows\n")
cat("Testing: 2023,", nrow(test), "rows\n")

# Check the cost distribution of training data
print(quantile(
  train$cost,
  probs = c(0, 0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 1)
))

```

```{r}
# random forest regressors for normal and log versions
# Do not delete large costs, use the same data and settings, and only change the transformation of the objective variable.

x_train <- train[, features, drop = FALSE]
x_test  <- test[, features, drop = FALSE]

y_train <- train$cost
y_test  <- test$cost

# A. Learn the cost as it is
rf_raw <- ranger(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  num.trees = 500,
  min.node.size = 20,
  mtry = 3,
  respect.unordered.factors = "order",
  seed = 440
)

# B. Learn log(1 + cost)
rf_log <- ranger(
  x = x_train,
  y = log1p(y_train),
  num.trees = 500,
  min.node.size = 20,
  mtry = 3,
  respect.unordered.factors = "order",
  seed = 440
)

# 2023 prediction
pred_raw <- predict(rf_raw, data = x_test)$predictions

# log version returns to original dollar unit after prediction
pred_log <- expm1(
  predict(rf_log, data = x_test)$predictions
)

```


# 2023 ver

```{r}
# MAE / RMSE in 2023
# The log version is also evaluated after converting it back to dollars instead of leaving it as a logarithm.

evaluate <- function(model_name, actual, predicted) {

  data.frame(
    model = model_name,
    test_year = 2023,
    n_test = length(actual),
    MAE = mean(abs(actual - predicted)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2)),
    total_bias_pct =
      100 * (sum(predicted) / sum(actual) - 1)
  )
}

results <- rbind(
  evaluate("Random forest: raw", y_test, pred_raw),
  evaluate("Random forest: log1p", y_test, pred_log)
)

print(results, row.names = FALSE, digits = 7)

# Show how the RMSE is small in this test
cat(
  "\nLower RMSE on 2023:",
  results$model[which.min(results$RMSE)],
  "\n"
)

```

```{r}
# save the results
predictions <- data.frame(
  pipe_id = test$pipe_id,
  leak_date = test$date,
  actual_cost = y_test,
  predicted_raw = pred_raw,
  predicted_log = pred_log
)

write.csv(
  results,
  "rf_metrics_2023.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  predictions,
  "rf_predictions_2023.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

head(predictions)
View(predictions)
```



# 2024 ver
```{r}

# 1. Data division for 2024
df$date <- as.Date(df$date)
df$event_year <- as.integer(format(df$date, "%Y"))

train_2024 <- subset(
  df, event_year >= 2019 & event_year <= 2023
)
test_2024 <- subset(df, event_year == 2024)

features <- c(
  "material", "surface", "pipe_length",
  "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x", "midpoint_y", "event_year"
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(train_2024) > 0,
  nrow(test_2024) > 0,
  !anyNA(train_2024[, c(features, "cost")]),
  !anyNA(test_2024[, c(features, "cost")]),
  all(train_2024$cost > 0),
  all(test_2024$cost > 0)
)

# 2. Processing categories
for (col in c("material", "surface")) {

  categories <- sort(unique(as.character(train_2024[[col]])))

  unseen <- setdiff(
    as.character(test_2024[[col]]), categories
  )

  if (length(unseen) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Category not in training data:", col))
  }

  train_2024[[col]] <- factor(
    train_2024[[col]], levels = categories
  )
  test_2024[[col]] <- factor(
    test_2024[[col]], levels = categories
  )
}

# 3. Update input and correct answer
x_train_2024 <- train_2024[, features, drop = FALSE]
x_test_2024  <- test_2024[, features, drop = FALSE]

y_train_2024 <- train_2024$cost
y_test_2024  <- test_2024$cost

# 4. New learning of the regular version
rf_raw_2024 <- ranger(
  x = x_train_2024,
  y = y_train_2024,
  num.trees = 500,
  min.node.size = 20,
  mtry = 3,
  respect.unordered.factors = "order",
  seed = 440
)

# 5. Learn new log version
rf_log_2024 <- ranger(
  x = x_train_2024,
  y = log1p(y_train_2024),
  num.trees = 500,
  min.node.size = 20,
  mtry = 3,
  respect.unordered.factors = "order",
  seed = 440
)

# 6. Forecast using 2024 data
pred_raw_2024 <- predict(
  rf_raw_2024, data = x_test_2024
)$predictions

pred_log_2024 <- expm1(
  predict(rf_log_2024, data = x_test_2024)$predictions
)

# 7. Check the number and predicted value
stopifnot(
  length(pred_raw_2024) == nrow(test_2024),
  length(pred_log_2024) == nrow(test_2024),
  all(is.finite(pred_raw_2024)),
  all(is.finite(pred_log_2024))
)

# 8. Valued in original dollars
evaluate_2024 <- function(name, predicted) {
  data.frame(
    model = name,
    test_year = 2024,
    n_test = length(y_test_2024),
    MAE = mean(abs(y_test_2024 - predicted)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((y_test_2024 - predicted)^2)),
    total_bias_pct =
      100 * (sum(predicted) / sum(y_test_2024) - 1)
  )
}

results_2024 <- rbind(
  evaluate_2024("Random forest: raw", pred_raw_2024),
  evaluate_2024("Random forest: log1p", pred_log_2024)
)

cat("Training rows:", nrow(train_2024), "\n")
cat("Testing rows:", nrow(test_2024), "\n")

print(results_2024, row.names = FALSE, digits = 7)

write.csv(
  results_2024,
  "rf_metrics_2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

# Gamma Regression

# 2023 ver
```{r}
# 1. Choose the years
train_start <- 2019
train_end   <- 2022
test_year   <- 2023

set.seed(440)

# 2. Read the prepared dataset
url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "reinesana/STAT440-star-kingdom-project/",
  "main/data/train_predict_cost.csv"
)

gamma_df <- read.csv(url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

gamma_df$date <- as.Date(gamma_df$date)
gamma_df$event_year <- as.integer(
  format(gamma_df$date, "%Y")
)

# 3. Split the data by year
gamma_train <- subset(
  gamma_df,
  event_year >= train_start & event_year <= train_end
)

gamma_test <- subset(
  gamma_df,
  event_year == test_year
)

features <- c(
  "material", "surface", "pipe_length",
  "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x", "midpoint_y", "event_year"
)

# Check the data without removing or capping large costs
stopifnot(
  nrow(gamma_train) > 0,
  nrow(gamma_test) > 0,
  !anyNA(gamma_train[, c(features, "cost")]),
  !anyNA(gamma_test[, c(features, "cost")]),
  all(gamma_train$cost > 0),
  all(gamma_test$cost > 0)
)

numeric_cols <- c(
  "cost", "pipe_length", "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x", "midpoint_y", "event_year"
)

for (col in numeric_cols) {
  stopifnot(
    is.numeric(gamma_train[[col]]),
    is.numeric(gamma_test[[col]]),
    all(is.finite(gamma_train[[col]])),
    all(is.finite(gamma_test[[col]]))
  )
}

# 4. Treat material and surface as categories
for (col in c("material", "surface")) {

  categories <- sort(unique(gamma_train[[col]]))
  unseen <- setdiff(unique(gamma_test[[col]]), categories)

  if (length(unseen) > 0) {
    stop(paste(
      "Unseen test category in", col, ":",
      paste(unseen, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  gamma_train[[col]] <- factor(
    gamma_train[[col]], levels = categories
  )
  gamma_test[[col]] <- factor(
    gamma_test[[col]], levels = categories
  )
}

# Center year for numerical stability.
# The reference is calculated from training data only.
year_reference <- mean(gamma_train$event_year)

gamma_train$year_centered <-
  gamma_train$event_year - year_reference

gamma_test$year_centered <-
  gamma_test$event_year - year_reference

# 5. Fit Gamma regression with a log link
# The target remains the original dollar cost.
gamma_model <- glm(
  cost ~ material + surface + pipe_length +
    years_used_at_leak + midpoint_x + midpoint_y +
    year_centered,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = gamma_train,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 100)
)

if (!isTRUE(gamma_model$converged)) {
  stop("Gamma model did not converge. Check before reporting results.")
}

# 6. Predict directly in dollars
gamma_pred <- predict(
  gamma_model,
  newdata = gamma_test,
  type = "response"
)

stopifnot(
  length(gamma_pred) == nrow(gamma_test),
  all(is.finite(gamma_pred)),
  all(gamma_pred > 0)
)

# 7. Calculate MAE and RMSE
actual <- gamma_test$cost

gamma_results <- data.frame(
  model = "Gamma regression (log link)",
  training_years = paste(train_start, train_end, sep = "-"),
  test_year = test_year,
  n_train = nrow(gamma_train),
  n_test = nrow(gamma_test),
  MAE = mean(abs(actual - gamma_pred)),
  RMSE = sqrt(mean((actual - gamma_pred)^2)),
  total_bias_pct =
    100 * (sum(gamma_pred) / sum(actual) - 1)
)

print(gamma_results, row.names = FALSE, digits = 7)

# 8. Save results with the training period in the filename
file_label <- paste0(
  "gamma_train_", train_start, "_", train_end,
  "_test_", test_year
)

write.csv(
  gamma_results,
  paste0(file_label, "_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

gamma_predictions <- data.frame(
  pipe_id = gamma_test$pipe_id,
  leak_date = gamma_test$date,
  actual_cost = actual,
  predicted_gamma = as.numeric(gamma_pred)
)

write.csv(
  gamma_predictions,
  paste0(file_label, "_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
# Fold 2: train on 2019–2024, test on 2025
train_start <- 2019
train_end   <- 2024
test_year   <- 2025

set.seed(440)
# 2. Read the prepared dataset
url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "reinesana/STAT440-star-kingdom-project/",
  "main/data/train_predict_cost.csv"
)

gamma_df <- read.csv(url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

gamma_df$date <- as.Date(gamma_df$date)
gamma_df$event_year <- as.integer(
  format(gamma_df$date, "%Y")
)

# 3. Split the data by year
gamma_train <- subset(
  gamma_df,
  event_year >= train_start & event_year <= train_end
)

gamma_test <- subset(
  gamma_df,
  event_year == test_year
)

features <- c(
  "material", "surface", "pipe_length",
  "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x", "midpoint_y", "event_year"
)

# Check the data without removing or capping large costs
stopifnot(
  nrow(gamma_train) > 0,
  nrow(gamma_test) > 0,
  !anyNA(gamma_train[, c(features, "cost")]),
  !anyNA(gamma_test[, c(features, "cost")]),
  all(gamma_train$cost > 0),
  all(gamma_test$cost > 0)
)

numeric_cols <- c(
  "cost", "pipe_length", "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x", "midpoint_y", "event_year"
)

for (col in numeric_cols) {
  stopifnot(
    is.numeric(gamma_train[[col]]),
    is.numeric(gamma_test[[col]]),
    all(is.finite(gamma_train[[col]])),
    all(is.finite(gamma_test[[col]]))
  )
}

# 4. Treat material and surface as categories
for (col in c("material", "surface")) {

  categories <- sort(unique(gamma_train[[col]]))
  unseen <- setdiff(unique(gamma_test[[col]]), categories)

  if (length(unseen) > 0) {
    stop(paste(
      "Unseen test category in", col, ":",
      paste(unseen, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  gamma_train[[col]] <- factor(
    gamma_train[[col]], levels = categories
  )
  gamma_test[[col]] <- factor(
    gamma_test[[col]], levels = categories
  )
}

# Center year for numerical stability.
# The reference is calculated from training data only.
year_reference <- mean(gamma_train$event_year)

gamma_train$year_centered <-
  gamma_train$event_year - year_reference

gamma_test$year_centered <-
  gamma_test$event_year - year_reference

# 5. Fit Gamma regression with a log link
# The target remains the original dollar cost.
gamma_model <- glm(
  cost ~ material + surface + pipe_length +
    years_used_at_leak + midpoint_x + midpoint_y +
    year_centered,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = gamma_train,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 100)
)

if (!isTRUE(gamma_model$converged)) {
  stop("Gamma model did not converge. Check before reporting results.")
}

# 6. Predict directly in dollars
gamma_pred <- predict(
  gamma_model,
  newdata = gamma_test,
  type = "response"
)

stopifnot(
  length(gamma_pred) == nrow(gamma_test),
  all(is.finite(gamma_pred)),
  all(gamma_pred > 0)
)

# 7. Calculate MAE and RMSE
actual <- gamma_test$cost

gamma_results <- data.frame(
  model = "Gamma regression (log link)",
  training_years = paste(train_start, train_end, sep = "-"),
  test_year = test_year,
  n_train = nrow(gamma_train),
  n_test = nrow(gamma_test),
  MAE = mean(abs(actual - gamma_pred)),
  RMSE = sqrt(mean((actual - gamma_pred)^2)),
  total_bias_pct =
    100 * (sum(gamma_pred) / sum(actual) - 1)
)

print(gamma_results, row.names = FALSE, digits = 7)

# 8. Save results with the training period in the filename
file_label <- paste0(
  "gamma_train_", train_start, "_", train_end,
  "_test_", test_year
)

write.csv(
  gamma_results,
  paste0(file_label, "_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

gamma_predictions <- data.frame(
  pipe_id = gamma_test$pipe_id,
  leak_date = gamma_test$date,
  actual_cost = actual,
  predicted_gamma = as.numeric(gamma_pred)
)

write.csv(
  gamma_predictions,
  paste0(file_label, "_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# LightGBM


# 2023 ver
```{r}
library(lightgbm)

# 1. Set the year
train_start <- 2019
train_end   <- 2022
test_year   <- 2023

set.seed(440)

# 2. Load data
url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "reinesana/STAT440-star-kingdom-project/",
  "main/data/train_predict_cost.csv"
)

lgb_df <- read.csv(url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

lgb_df$date <- as.Date(lgb_df$date)
lgb_df$event_year <- as.integer(
  format(lgb_df$date, "%Y")
)

# 3. Divide by year
lgb_train <- subset(
  lgb_df,
  event_year >= train_start & event_year <= train_end
)

lgb_test <- subset(
  lgb_df,
  event_year == test_year
)

features <- c(
  "material", "surface", "pipe_length",
  "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x", "midpoint_y", "event_year"
)

# Check for missing or invalid values. Leave the high costs as is
stopifnot(
  nrow(lgb_train) > 0,
  nrow(lgb_test) > 0,
  !anyNA(lgb_train[, c(features, "cost")]),
  !anyNA(lgb_test[, c(features, "cost")]),
  all(lgb_train$cost > 0),
  all(lgb_test$cost > 0)
)

numeric_cols <- c(
  "cost", "pipe_length", "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x", "midpoint_y", "event_year"
)

for (col in numeric_cols) {
  stopifnot(
    is.numeric(lgb_train[[col]]),
    is.numeric(lgb_test[[col]]),
    all(is.finite(lgb_train[[col]])),
    all(is.finite(lgb_test[[col]]))
  )
}

# 4. Match the training data category
for (col in c("material", "surface")) {

  categories <- sort(unique(lgb_train[[col]]))
  unseen <- setdiff(unique(lgb_test[[col]]), categories)

  if (length(unseen) > 0) {
    stop(paste(
      "Unseen test category in", col, ":",
      paste(unseen, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  lgb_train[[col]] <- factor(
    lgb_train[[col]], levels = categories
  )

  lgb_test[[col]] <- factor(
    lgb_test[[col]], levels = categories
  )
}

# 5. Convert categories to 0/1 columns and create a numerical matrix
x_formula <- ~ material + surface + pipe_length +
  years_used_at_leak + midpoint_x + midpoint_y +
  event_year - 1

x_train_lgb <- model.matrix(x_formula, data = lgb_train)
x_test_lgb  <- model.matrix(x_formula, data = lgb_test)

stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(x_train_lgb), colnames(x_test_lgb))
)

# Organize column names for LightGBM
safe_names <- make.names(
  colnames(x_train_lgb), unique = TRUE
)

colnames(x_train_lgb) <- safe_names
colnames(x_test_lgb)  <- safe_names

y_train_lgb <- lgb_train$cost
y_test_lgb  <- lgb_test$cost

# 6. Common model settings
# First, compare with fixed settings. Test data is not used for learning
params <- list(
  objective = "regression",
  metric = "rmse",
  learning_rate = 0.05,
  num_leaves = 15L,
  min_data_in_leaf = 20L,
  feature_fraction = 1.0,
  bagging_fraction = 1.0,
  bagging_freq = 0L,
  seed = 440L,
  deterministic = TRUE,
  force_col_wise = TRUE,
  num_threads = 1L,
  verbosity = -1L
)

# 7. Regular version: Learn original cost
dtrain_raw <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = x_train_lgb,
  label = y_train_lgb
)

lgb_raw_model <- lgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain_raw,
  nrounds = 500L
)

# 8. log version: learn log1p(cost)
dtrain_log <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = x_train_lgb,
  label = log1p(y_train_lgb)
)

lgb_log_model <- lgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain_log,
  nrounds = 500L
)

# 9. Prediction
pred_raw_lgb <- predict(
  lgb_raw_model, newdata = x_test_lgb
)

pred_log_lgb <- expm1(
  predict(lgb_log_model, newdata = x_test_lgb)
)

stopifnot(
  length(pred_raw_lgb) == nrow(lgb_test),
  length(pred_log_lgb) == nrow(lgb_test),
  all(is.finite(pred_raw_lgb)),
  all(is.finite(pred_log_lgb))
)

# Since costs are non-negative, negative predictions are set to 0 in both models.
# This rule is fixed before seeing the evaluation results
cat("Negative predictions, raw:", sum(pred_raw_lgb < 0), "\n")
cat("Negative predictions, log:", sum(pred_log_lgb < 0), "\n")

pred_raw_lgb <- pmax(0, pred_raw_lgb)
pred_log_lgb <- pmax(0, pred_log_lgb)

# 10. Valued in original dollars
evaluate_lgb <- function(name, predicted) {
  data.frame(
    model = name,
    training_years = paste(
      train_start, train_end, sep = "-"
    ),
    test_year = test_year,
    n_train = nrow(lgb_train),
    n_test = nrow(lgb_test),
    MAE = mean(abs(y_test_lgb - predicted)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((y_test_lgb - predicted)^2)),
    total_bias_pct =
      100 * (sum(predicted) / sum(y_test_lgb) - 1)
  )
}

lgb_results <- rbind(
  evaluate_lgb("LightGBM: raw", pred_raw_lgb),
  evaluate_lgb("LightGBM: log1p", pred_log_lgb)
)

cat(
  "\nTraining:", train_start, "-", train_end,
  ",", nrow(lgb_train), "rows\n"
)
cat("Evaluation:", test_year, ",", nrow(lgb_test), "rows\n")

print(lgb_results, row.names = FALSE, digits = 7)

# 11. Save
file_label <- paste0(
  "lightgbm_train_", train_start, "_", train_end,
  "_test_", test_year
)

write.csv(
  lgb_results,
  paste0(file_label, "_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

lgb_predictions <- data.frame(
  pipe_id = lgb_test$pipe_id,
  leak_date = lgb_test$date,
  actual_cost = y_test_lgb,
  predicted_raw = pred_raw_lgb,
  predicted_log = pred_log_lgb
)

write.csv(
  lgb_predictions,
  paste0(file_label, "_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
  !anyNA(lgb_test[, c(features, "cost")]),
  all(lgb_train$cost > 0),
  all(lgb_test$cost > 0)
)

numeric_cols <- c(
  "cost", "pipe_length", "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x", "midpoint_y", "event_year"
)

for (col in numeric_cols) {
  stopifnot(
    is.numeric(lgb_train[[col]]),
    is.numeric(lgb_test[[col]]),
    all(is.finite(lgb_train[[col]])),
    all(is.finite(lgb_test[[col]]))
  )
}

# 4. Match the training data category
for (col in c("material", "surface")) {

  categories <- sort(unique(lgb_train[[col]]))
  unseen <- setdiff(unique(lgb_test[[col]]), categories)

  if (length(unseen) > 0) {
    stop(paste(
      "Unseen test category in", col, ":",
      paste(unseen, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  lgb_train[[col]] <- factor(
    lgb_train[[col]], levels = categories
  )

  lgb_test[[col]] <- factor(
    lgb_test[[col]], levels = categories
  )
}

# 5. Convert categories to 0/1 columns and create a numerical matrix
x_formula <- ~ material + surface + pipe_length +
  years_used_at_leak + midpoint_x + midpoint_y +
  event_year - 1

x_train_lgb <- model.matrix(x_formula, data = lgb_train)
x_test_lgb  <- model.matrix(x_formula, data = lgb_test)

stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(x_train_lgb), colnames(x_test_lgb))
)

# Organize column names for LightGBM
safe_names <- make.names(
  colnames(x_train_lgb), unique = TRUE
)

colnames(x_train_lgb) <- safe_names
colnames(x_test_lgb)  <- safe_names

y_train_lgb <- lgb_train$cost
y_test_lgb  <- lgb_test$cost

# 6. Common model settings
# First, compare with fixed settings. Test data is not used for learning
params <- list(
  objective = "regression",
  metric = "rmse",
  learning_rate = 0.05,
  num_leaves = 15L,
  min_data_in_leaf = 20L,
  feature_fraction = 1.0,
  bagging_fraction = 1.0,
  bagging_freq = 0L,
  seed = 440L,
  deterministic = TRUE,
  force_col_wise = TRUE,
  num_threads = 1L,
  verbosity = -1L
)

# 7. Regular version: Learn original cost
dtrain_raw <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = x_train_lgb,
  label = y_train_lgb
)

lgb_raw_model <- lgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain_raw,
  nrounds = 500L
)

# 8. log version: learn log1p(cost)
dtrain_log <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = x_train_lgb,
  label = log1p(y_train_lgb)
)

lgb_log_model <- lgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain_log,
  nrounds = 500L
)

# 9. Prediction
pred_raw_lgb <- predict(
  lgb_raw_model, newdata = x_test_lgb
)

pred_log_lgb <- expm1(
  predict(lgb_log_model, newdata = x_test_lgb)
)

stopifnot(
  length(pred_raw_lgb) == nrow(lgb_test),
  length(pred_log_lgb) == nrow(lgb_test),
  all(is.finite(pred_raw_lgb)),
  all(is.finite(pred_log_lgb))
)

# Since costs are non-negative, negative predictions are set to 0 in both models.
# This rule is fixed before seeing the evaluation results
cat("Negative predictions, raw:", sum(pred_raw_lgb < 0), "\n")
cat("Negative predictions, log:", sum(pred_log_lgb < 0), "\n")

pred_raw_lgb <- pmax(0, pred_raw_lgb)
pred_log_lgb <- pmax(0, pred_log_lgb)

# 10. Valued in original dollars
evaluate_lgb <- function(name, predicted) {
  data.frame(
    model = name,
    training_years = paste(
      train_start, train_end, sep = "-"
    ),
    test_year = test_year,
    n_train = nrow(lgb_train),
    n_test = nrow(lgb_test),
    MAE = mean(abs(y_test_lgb - predicted)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((y_test_lgb - predicted)^2)),
    total_bias_pct =
      100 * (sum(predicted) / sum(y_test_lgb) - 1)
  )
}

lgb_results <- rbind(
  evaluate_lgb("LightGBM: raw", pred_raw_lgb),
  evaluate_lgb("LightGBM: log1p", pred_log_lgb)
)

cat(
  "\nTraining:", train_start, "-", train_end,
  ",", nrow(lgb_train), "rows\n"
)
cat("Evaluation:", test_year, ",", nrow(lgb_test), "rows\n")

print(lgb_results, row.names = FALSE, digits = 7)

# 11. Save
file_label <- paste0(
  "lightgbm_train_", train_start, "_", train_end,
  "_test_", test_year
)

write.csv(
  lgb_results,
  paste0(file_label, "_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

lgb_predictions <- data.frame(
  pipe_id = lgb_test$pipe_id,
  leak_date = lgb_test$date,
  actual_cost = y_test_lgb,
  predicted_raw = pred_raw_lgb,
  predicted_log = pred_log_lgb
)

write.csv(
  lgb_predictions,
  paste0(file_label, "_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```



# 2026 ver
```{r}
set.seed(440)

# 1. Load data
url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "reinesana/STAT440-star-kingdom-project/",
  "main/data/train_predict_cost.csv"
)

lgb_df_2026 <- read.csv(url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

lgb_df_2026$date <- as.Date(lgb_df_2026$date)
lgb_df_2026$event_year <- as.integer(
  format(lgb_df_2026$date, "%Y")
)

# 2. Study: 2019-2025, Final test: 2026
lgb_train_2026 <- subset(
  lgb_df_2026,
  event_year >= 2019 & event_year <= 2025
)

lgb_test_2026 <- subset(
  lgb_df_2026,
  event_year == 2026
)

features_2026 <- c(
  "material",
  "surface",
  "pipe_length",
  "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x",
  "midpoint_y",
  "event_year"
)

# 3. Check the data
# Use as is without deleting or capping expensive repair costs
stopifnot(
  nrow(lgb_train_2026) > 0,
  nrow(lgb_test_2026) > 0,
  !anyNA(lgb_train_2026[, c(features_2026, "cost")]),
  !anyNA(lgb_test_2026[, c(features_2026, "cost")]),
  all(lgb_train_2026$cost > 0),
  all(lgb_test_2026$cost > 0)
)

numeric_cols_2026 <- c(
  "cost",
  "pipe_length",
  "years_used_at_leak",
  "midpoint_x",
  "midpoint_y",
  "event_year"
)

for (col in numeric_cols_2026) {
  stopifnot(
    is.numeric(lgb_train_2026[[col]]),
    is.numeric(lgb_test_2026[[col]]),
    all(is.finite(lgb_train_2026[[col]])),
    all(is.finite(lgb_test_2026[[col]]))
  )
}

# 4. Match categories to training data
for (col in c("material", "surface")) {

  categories <- sort(unique(lgb_train_2026[[col]]))

  unseen <- setdiff(
    unique(lgb_test_2026[[col]]),
    categories
  )

  if (length(unseen) > 0) {
    stop(paste(
      "Unseen test category in", col, ":",
      paste(unseen, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  lgb_train_2026[[col]] <- factor(
    lgb_train_2026[[col]],
    levels = categories
  )

  lgb_test_2026[[col]] <- factor(
    lgb_test_2026[[col]],
    levels = categories
  )
}

# 5. Create a numerical matrix
x_formula_2026 <- ~ material + surface + pipe_length +
  years_used_at_leak + midpoint_x + midpoint_y +
  event_year - 1

x_train_lgb_2026 <- model.matrix(
  x_formula_2026,
  data = lgb_train_2026
)

x_test_lgb_2026 <- model.matrix(
  x_formula_2026,
  data = lgb_test_2026
)

stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(x_train_lgb_2026),
    colnames(x_test_lgb_2026)
  )
)

safe_names <- make.names(
  colnames(x_train_lgb_2026),
  unique = TRUE
)

colnames(x_train_lgb_2026) <- safe_names
colnames(x_test_lgb_2026) <- safe_names

y_train_lgb_2026 <- lgb_train_2026$cost
y_test_lgb_2026 <- lgb_test_2026$cost

# 6. Same model settings as 2025
params_2026 <- list(
  objective = "regression",
  metric = "rmse",
  learning_rate = 0.05,
  num_leaves = 15L,
  min_data_in_leaf = 20L,
  feature_fraction = 1.0,
  bagging_fraction = 1.0,
  bagging_freq = 0L,
  seed = 440L,
  deterministic = TRUE,
  force_col_wise = TRUE,
  num_threads = 1L,
  verbosity = -1L
)

# 7. Learning with log1p(cost)
dtrain_log_2026 <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = x_train_lgb_2026,
  label = log1p(y_train_lgb_2026)
)

lgb_log_model_2026 <- lgb.train(
  params = params_2026,
  data = dtrain_log_2026,
  nrounds = 500L
)

# 8. Predict 2026 and convert back to dollars
pred_log_lgb_2026 <- expm1(
  predict(
    lgb_log_model_2026,
    newdata = x_test_lgb_2026
  )
)

stopifnot(
  length(pred_log_lgb_2026) == nrow(lgb_test_2026),
  all(is.finite(pred_log_lgb_2026))
)

# Same rule as previous year: Negative cost forecasts should be 0
cat(
  "Negative predictions:",
  sum(pred_log_lgb_2026 < 0),
  "\n"
)

pred_log_lgb_2026 <- pmax(0, pred_log_lgb_2026)

# 9. Calculate MAE/RMSE in original dollar units
lgb_results_2026 <- data.frame(
  model = "LightGBM: log1p",
  training_years = "2019-2025",
  test_year = 2026,
  n_train = nrow(lgb_train_2026),
  n_test = nrow(lgb_test_2026),

  MAE = mean(
    abs(y_test_lgb_2026 - pred_log_lgb_2026)
  ),

  RMSE = sqrt(mean(
    (y_test_lgb_2026 - pred_log_lgb_2026)^2
  )),

  total_bias_pct = 100 * (
    sum(pred_log_lgb_2026) / sum(y_test_lgb_2026) - 1
  )
)

cat(
  "\nTraining: 2019–2025,",
  nrow(lgb_train_2026), "rows\n"
)

cat(
  "Final test: 2026,",
  nrow(lgb_test_2026), "rows\n"
)

print(
  lgb_results_2026,
  row.names = FALSE,
  digits = 7
)

# 10. Save evaluation results
write.csv(
  lgb_results_2026,
  "lightgbm_log_train_2019_2025_test_2026_metrics.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 11. Save predictions for each pipe
lgb_predictions_2026 <- data.frame(
  pipe_id = lgb_test_2026$pipe_id,
  leak_date = lgb_test_2026$date,
  actual_cost = y_test_lgb_2026,
  predicted_log = pred_log_lgb_2026
)

write.csv(
  lgb_predictions_2026,
  "lightgbm_log_train_2019_2025_test_2026_predictions.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
